title: Side-effect ledger entry v0
description: One tool call that can change something (a command, a message, a memory or claim write, later file edits and deployments). The entry is written BEFORE the call runs ('intent') and updated after it. After a crash, an entry still in 'intent' becomes 'unknown': it may or may not have happened. Recovery never repeats an unknown or non-retryable effect automatically.

effect_class.description: internal: changes only Code Doctor's own records (memory, claims, messages). external: can change the examined project or the outside world (commands, file edits, deployments, network calls).

retry_safe.description: true only if running it twice has the same effect as once. Decided by the tool definition, never by the model.

state.description: intent: recorded, about to run. done / failed: finished with a known result. unknown: the service stopped between intent and result.
